title: VARIOUS VINTAGE RECORDS
reason: A Beatles 'with the beatles' LP in a non-standard looking cover (possible overseas or unofficial pressing, unidentified) in a box of 1960s and 70s records including ABBA Arrival; vinyl condition unknown.
findings: Under-described: about 20 LPs, EPs and 7 inch singles seen only as a spread of covers. The standout is a 'with the beatles' LP whose cover does not match the standard UK Freeman sleeve: four black and white portraits arranged in a diamond, a bold pink hand-lettered title at lower right and a small white Parlophone-style logo box at top right (text too small to read). It could be an overseas or unofficial pressing; the country, edition and label cannot be identified from the photo. Others identified from the covers: 'The Most of Herman's Hermits' (purple cover), 'The Del Shannon Anniversary Album' (lime green), an LP with large orange lettering starting 'ROBES...' (probably Paul Robeson) with a Verve logo and a gold star sticker, a Johnny Cash LP (title hidden), an LP with vertical lettering that may read CHER, a blue Billy Joel LP (looks like The Bridge), Shirley Bassey 'The Bassey Beat', ABBA 'Arrival' (RCA Victor), a Vera Lynn EP, a gold glitter cover reading 'THE PLA...', a PYE paper sleeve and several RCA 7 inch singles with orange labels in RCA company sleeves. Catalogue numbers, labels and vinyl are not visible.
condition: Only covers and sleeves are visible; vinyl condition unknown. The Beatles cover looks glossy with light edge scuffing and a few creases; the Johnny Cash and Robeson covers show edge wear; some covers are in plastic sleeves; the singles sleeves are aged paper.
rescore_note: About 20 mixed records; standout is a 'with the beatles' LP in a non-standard cover (pink title, four heads in a diamond, Parlophone style logo), so probably an overseas licensed or unofficial pressing of unknown rarity; rest are common 1960s to 70s LPs (ABBA Arrival, Cash, Bassey) and RCA singles, vinyl unseen; low end of the $80-200 band. No comp seen.
